therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Complement inhibition by blocking C5 cleavage
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of complement-mediated destruction at the neuromuscular junction
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Pediatric participants with refractory generalized myasthenia gravis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in QMG total score at week 26

results.target_engagement_evidence: Complete suppression of free complement component 5 (baseline 172.7 μg/mL to 0.0 μg/mL at all post-dose timepoints) and reduction in hemolysis from 105.8% at baseline to <2% at all post-dose timepoints
biomarker_changes: Free complement C5 reduced from 172.7 μg/mL to 0.0 μg/mL
subgroup_findings: 70% of participants achieved ≥5-point reduction in QMG score
50% of participants achieved ≥3-point reduction in MG-ADL score
results.dose_information: IV infusion, specific dose not provided
